title: Full-Stack Engineer (Node.js + React/Next.js)
description:

You will design and implement robust APIs, develop server-side features, and build responsive applications using React and Next.js.
  
  
You will also contribute to cloud-based solutions, leveraging Microsoft Azure to deploy and maintain reliable applications.
  
  
Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help deliver efficient, secure, and scalable software solutions.

* Proven experience implementing Next.js server-side features, including route handlers, server actions, SSR data fetching, and server-side sessions.
* Practical experience integrating Next.js applications with separate backend APIs.
* Hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining applications on Microsoft Azure.

title: Video Gen AI Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Video Gen AI Engineer based in India.**
This role offers the opportunity to build and optimize advanced AI-powered video generation systems for large-scale content production. You will work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, multimedia engineering, and high-performance computing to transform raw media assets into dynamic, engaging video content. The position spans applications in gaming, advertising technology, and immersive Unity environments. You will design scalable video processing and rendering pipelines, improve production efficiency, and integrate emerging AI capabilities into practical engineering solutions. Working with product, engineering, and ad tech teams, you will help turn creative and business requirements into reliable technical systems. This is a remote opportunity suited to both emerging and experienced engineers who are eager to experiment, innovate, and contribute to next-generation video technology.

* Video Generation Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain end-to-end video generation pipelines using FFmpeg, custom AI models, and multimedia processing frameworks to produce high-quality content efficiently.

* Scalable Rendering Solutions: Develop and improve rendering architectures capable of supporting both real-time and batch video processing, with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Unity Integration: Integrate generated video assets into Unity environments, supporting gaming applications and interactive digital experiences.
* Dynamic Advertising Content: Collaborate with advertising technology teams to develop and deliver dynamic video advertisements at scale, supporting relevant ad formats and insertion workflows.

* Technical Guidance: Share engineering knowledge, mentor junior team members, and promote best practices in code quality, system design, and development workflows.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with product managers and multidisciplinary teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and deliver effective engineering solutions.

**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: Open to candidates with 0+ years of experience, including early-career engineers with strong technical foundations and the ability to learn quickly.
* FFmpeg and Media Processing: Proficiency with FFmpeg and experience scripting or building complex media processing and video editing workflows.
* Programming Skills: Strong programming abilities in Python, C++, or Rust, particularly for developing performance-critical components and efficient processing systems.
* GPU-Accelerated Computing: Hands-on experience with GPU-accelerated rendering pipelines and technologies such as CUDA or OpenGL.
* Unity Development: Knowledge of Unity scripting and asset pipeline integration, ideally with an understanding of video workflows in gaming or interactive applications.
* AI and Machine Learning: Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, particularly for video inference and integration of machine learning models into production pipelines.
* Distributed Systems and Cloud Platforms: Demonstrated ability to scale processing workloads across distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.
* Advertising Technology: Understanding of advertising technology standards such as VAST and VPAID, as well as dynamic ad insertion concepts.
* Problem-Solving and Initiative: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a proactive, self-directed approach to identifying challenges and delivering solutions.
* Communication and Collaboration: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with engineering, product, and other cross-functional teams.
* Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Enthusiasm for exploring new tools, keeping up with evolving technologies, and adapting to developments in AI and multimedia engineering.

title: Senior Product Support Engineer
description:
Development + Technical Support
  
  
**Experience:**
5–7 years
  
  
**Function:**
Product Engineering / Customer Success
  
  
**Employment type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Location:**
[Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote]
  
  
**Reports to:**
[Manager, Technical Support / Head of Engineering]
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a hybrid engineering and support role for someone who is equally comfortable debugging a customer’s production issue and writing the code that stops it happening again.
  
  
You will be the senior technical escalation point for our product across heterogeneous customer environments Windows, Linux and Solaris, integrated with enterprise Active Directory, SIEM platforms and a range of network infrastructure. Roughly half your time will be spent on deep troubleshooting and customer-facing escalation; the other half on building fixes, tooling, integrations and automation that reduce future ticket volume.
  
  
We are looking for someone who treats a recurring support ticket as a defect to be engineered away, not a queue to be worked through.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Troubleshooting and escalation**

* Own Level 3 escalations end to endreproduce, diagnose root cause, and drive to resolution across OS, network, database and application layers
* Analyse logs, packet captures, stack traces, core dumps and performance counters to isolate faults in complex multi-vendor environments
* Diagnose issues spanning customer infrastructure boundaries: authentication, directory services, firewalls, proxies, certificates and network policy
* Work directly with customer IT, security and infrastructure teams, including during high-severity incidents
* Produce clear root cause analysis documents for customer and internal audiences

**Development**

* Build and ship fixes, patches and product improvements in C# and Python
* Develop diagnostic tooling, log analysers, health-check scripts and automated reproduction harnesses
* Write and optimise SQL for investigation, data correction and performance analysis
* Build and maintain customer-facing integrationsActive Directory, SIEM connectors, APIs and data pipelines
* Contribute to product hardening: instrumentation, logging quality, error handling and observability

**Deployment and integration**

* Support installation, upgrade and configuration of the product across Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Solaris
* Configure and troubleshoot Active Directory / LDAP integration, Kerberos, SSO and certificate-based authentication
* Integrate product telemetry and event data with customer SIEM platforms
* Support cloud and hybrid deployments, including containerised environments

**Knowledge and enablement**

* Maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides
* Mentor junior support engineers and act as a technical reviewer on complex tickets
* Feed recurring issues and field insight back into the product roadmap

**Experience**
**Required skills and experience**

* 5–7 years in a combined engineering and technical support capacity, supporting an enterprise software product deployed in customer environments
* Demonstrable history of resolving complex, cross-system production issues

**Operating systems**

* Strong administration and troubleshooting on Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) systemd, journald, permissions, process and resource analysis, package management
* Windows Server administration — services, Event Viewer, registry, PowerShell, IIS, performance monitoring
* Working knowledge of Solaris or another commercial UNIX in a legacy enterprise context
* Shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell)

**Identity and security**

* Hands-on Active Directory integration: LDAP/LDAPS, Kerberos, group policy, service accounts, delegation, trusts
* Experience integrating applications with SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent) — log forwarding, syslog, CEF/LEEF, event normalisation
* Practical understanding of TLS/PKI, certificate management and common certificate failure modes

**Networking**

* Solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, NAT, firewalls, load balancers and proxies
* Ability to read and interpret packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump) to isolate connectivity and latency issues

**Development**

* Proficient in C# / .NET
* Proficient in Python for automation, tooling and data processing
* Comfortable with Git, code review and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read unfamiliar production code and trace a fault to its source

**Database**

* Strong SQL against at least one of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL
* Query performance analysis, indexing, execution plans, backup/restore, and basic administration

**Cloud**

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) — compute, networking, identity, storage and managed database services
* Familiarity with containerised deployment (Docker; Kubernetes an advantage)
* Understanding of hybrid architectures where product components span on-premises and cloud

**Desirable**

* Experience with email infrastructure and protocolsIMAP, SMTP, Exchange/EWS, Microsoft Graph
* Exposure to machine learning or classification systems in a production support context
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and observability tooling (Grafana, ELK, Prometheus)
* Certifications: RHCE/RHCSA, Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Security+
* Experience supporting regulated customers — financial services, healthcare or public sector
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, problem and change management

**What We Look For Beyond The Checklist**

* Structured diagnostic thinking. You form hypotheses and test them rather than changing settings until something works.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Enterprise environments are undocumented and inconsistent; you find your own way in.
* Customer-grade communication. You can explain a Kerberos delegation failure to a CISO and to a junior admin, correctly, in the same afternoon.
* Composure under pressure. You are calm and credible on a Severity 1 bridge call.
* A bias toward permanent fixes. You are more interested in the third occurrence never happening than in closing the ticket quickly.

title: Oracle EPM Cloud Technical Lead
description:
**1. Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Oracle EPM Cloud professional to lead day-to-day technical operations and help strengthen our application support model.

The person should have strong hands-on experience with Oracle Planning/EPBCS, EDMCS, Integration and Essbase, along with experience managing production support activities, coordinating technical resources, and working with business analysts and managed service providers.

We need someone who is technically independent, proactive, dependable, and comfortable taking ownership of issues through resolution. The expectation is that this person will gradually take over routine technical operations with minimal supervision.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day-to-day Oracle EPM Cloud technical operations and coordinate support activities with the existing AMS team.
* Provide hands-on technical expertise in Planning/EPBCS, EDMCS, Narrative reporting, Essbase, Groovy, calculation scripts, business rules, and integrations.
* Troubleshoot production issues, data load failures, calculation problems, application performance issues, and scheduled jobs.
* Coordinate incident resolution, root-cause analysis, monitoring, and preventive actions.
* Work closely with the BSA on requirements, technical feasibility, testing, and business-related issues.
* Establish support procedures, SLAs, escalation processes, documentation, and primary/backup coverage.
* Coordinate with implementation partners on technical reviews, enhancements, deployments, and knowledge transfer.
* Support integration activities involving SAP, Oracle EBS, and other enterprise systems.
* Review existing support capabilities, identify gaps, and recommend additional resources as needed.
* Help build and mentor a technically capable, self-sufficient EPM support team.
* Follow established change-management, access-control, and segregation-of-duties procedures.
* Provide regular operational updates, identify risks early, and escalate significant issues appropriately.

**3. Required Technical Experience**

**Mandatory**

* Strong hands-on Oracle EPM Cloud Planning/EPBCS, EDMCS, Narrative Reporting experience.
* Strong Essbase knowledge, including BSO/ASO, calculation scripts, and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience developing and troubleshooting Groovy business rules.
* Experience with Planning application metadata, forms, data maps, and calculation processes.
* Strong experience with EPM Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, and automated data loads.
* Experience supporting business-critical Oracle EPM production environments.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
* Experience coordinating production support teams, incidents, releases, and operational activities.

**Preferred**

* On-premises Hyperion Planning, Essbase, ODI, or DRM experience.
* SAP, Oracle EBS, or Workday integration experience.
* Experience establishing or improving an AMS/MSP operating model.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes, SLAs, change management, and segregation of duties.

**4. Leadership and Communication**

We are looking for a seasoned professional with good technical judgment and strong interpersonal skills.

The candidate should be able to:

* Take ownership without waiting for repeated follow-ups.
* Communicate clearly with US-based IT and business teams.
* Work collaboratively with the BSA, AMS, and implementation partners.
* Lead technical discussions confidently and respectfully.
* Guide other technical resources and hold them accountable for assigned work.
* Handle disagreements professionally and provide practical recommendations.
* Manage routine operational activities independently while escalating major risks and decisions.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position. We are not looking for someone whose primary experience is project management, status reporting, or coordination.

**5. Reporting and Responsibilities**

The resource will work under the operational direction of Finance IT.

The lead will own day-to-day technical operations, troubleshooting, AMS technical coordination, and support team development.
